mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline in the prior month is associated with negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of observations over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk and depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of RSAFS and HOUST in the prior month is followed by positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In stagflationary regimes characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO < 99) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is forced to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Stagflationary conditions (INDPRO < 99 and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%) are followed by positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 thousand persons signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth above 150,000 thousand persons is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of observations over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential investment (RSAFS) exceeds $450,000 million, it indicates a robust housing market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS above $450,000 million is followed by negative 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signal a 'soft landing' monetary policy that supports equities, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% is followed by negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (GDPC1 annualized growth > 1.5%) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 850), the economy experiences a robust expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Strong expansionary conditions (GDPC1 annualized growth > 1.5% and HOUST > 850) are followed by negative 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
